# Rotoun Plastic

> Leading Chinese manufacturer and supplier of rotomolding plastics including LLDPE, HDPE, XHPE, PP, and PA materials for industrial applications.

Zhejiang Rotoun Plastic Technology Corp. specializes in rotational molding materials with R&D and production capabilities. The company serves global markets through multiple language versions of their website and participates in major industry trade shows.

## Key Topics

- LLDPE
- HDPE
- XHPE
- Rotomolding
- Rotational molding
- PP (Polypropylene)
- PA (Polyamide)
- Plastic materials
- Industrial plastics
- Stone Effect
- Rotomolding materials
- Polyethylene
- Manufacturing
- Plastic supplier
- Wholesale
